scientific_integrity: The two-point Palm distribution and signed count-law expansion are proved in RESULT.md. Rational sign certificates in verify_bandpass.py are proof aids, not empirical evidence for the infinite theorem. General pair correlations and the first-order Poisson limit are credited to earlier literature.
scientific_limitations: Fixed homogeneous Poisson input on the unit circle and one-through-three-neighbor band-pass rule. At least two parameter roots; uniqueness not asserted. Count total variation only, no full point-process speed claim. Independent audit not performed.
title: Reentrant variance matching and accelerated Poisson approximation for band-pass neighbour thinning
